class Student:
    def __init__(self, aNumber, aMentor):
        self._number = aNumber
        self._mentor = None
        if not self.setMentor(aMentor):
            raise RuntimeError("Unable to create student due to mentor. See https://manual.umple.org?RE002ViolationofAssociationMultiplicity.html")

    def setNumber(self, aNumber):
        self._number = aNumber
        return True

    def getNumber(self):
        return self._number

    def getMentor(self):
        return self._mentor

    def setMentor(self, aNewMentor):
        if aNewMentor is None:
            return False
        existingStudent = aNewMentor.getStudent()
        if existingStudent is not None and existingStudent is not self:
            return False
        anOldMentor = self._mentor
        self._mentor = aNewMentor
        self._mentor.setStudent(self)
        if anOldMentor is not None:
            anOldMentor.setStudent(None)
        return True

    def delete(self):
        existingMentor = self._mentor
        self._mentor = None
        if existingMentor is not None:
            existingMentor.setStudent(None)

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "number:" + str(self.getNumber())
                + "]"
                + "\n  mentor = " + ("null" if self.getMentor() is None else format(id(self.getMentor()), "x")))
